## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#107.

- Allows selecting multiple audio files in the Audio to Video flow.
- Converts selected files sequentially into separate videos using the existing converter settings for each file.
- Captures the requested output format once per batch so selecting MP4 applies to every file unless that specific conversion genuinely falls back through the existing encoder fallback path.
- Names rendered videos from the source audio filename and the actual rendered blob MIME type, so MP4 blobs are saved/listed as `.mp4` even if stale metadata says WebM.
- Adds a Save All button above the recordings list.
- Saves all rendered videos through one Electron folder selection when available, or sequential browser downloads otherwise.
- Merges the latest upstream `main` changes to resolve PR conflicts.
- Adds latest issue/PR/CI logs, the owner-provided screenshot, timeline, root-cause analysis, and implementation analysis under `docs/case-studies/issue-107`.

## How to Reproduce

1. Open the example app.
2. Go to Audio to Video.
3. Select more than one audio file.
4. Select MP4 as the output format.
5. Click Convert to Video.
6. Confirm each selected audio file is requested as MP4 and rendered/listed as MP4 unless the converter reports a real MP4 encoder fallback for that file.
7. Click Save All.
8. In Electron, choose the destination folder once and confirm all rendered videos are written there with matching `.mp4` filenames for MP4 blobs.

## Verification

- `npm test -- --runInBand` - 335 passed
- `npm run build` - passed with existing Rollup warnings
- `npx cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/batch-visualization.cy.js --config baseUrl=http://127.0.0.1:8081` - 5 passed

## Notes

Browser Save All still triggers one download per generated video because browsers do not allow silent arbitrary-folder writes. Electron uses one directory picker for the batch and shows the first saved item in that folder after writing all videos.
